{"language":"python","code":"
import re, io
p = 'website_museum_ollama-mimo-v2.6-flash-rl-mxfp4_01.html'
s = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()

checks = {}
checks['sections'] = [m for m in re.findall(r'<section[^>]*id="([^"]+)"', s)]
checks['nav_links'] = re.findall(r'<a[^>]*href="#([^"]+)"[^>]*class="nav-link"[^>]*>([^<]*)', s)
checks['artist_cards'] = len(re.findall(r'data-artist="', s))
checks['timeline_items'] = len(re.findall(r'class="timeline-item|class="tl-item|class="program-item', s))
checks['ticket_tiers'] = len(re.findall(r'data-tier="', s))
checks['faq_items'] = len(re.findall(r'class="faq-item|aria-expanded=', s))
checks['unsplash_imgs'] = len(re.findall(r'source\.unsplash\.com', s))
checks['ics'] = '20261018T190000' in s and '20261019T020000' in s and 'artifact-museum-night.ics' in s
checks['svg_map'] = bool(re.search(r'<svg[^>]*viewBox', s[s.find('id="venue"'):s.find('id="venue"')+8000])) if 'id="venue"' in s else False
checks['has_footer_note'] = 'no real ticket purchase' in s.lower()
checks['has_sticky'] = 'sticky' in s
checks['has_focus_visible'] = ':focus-visible' in s
checks['has_reduced_motion'] = 'prefers-reduced-motion' in s
checks['has_og'] = 'og:title' in s and 'og:description' in s and 'og:image' in s
checks['has_favicon'] = 'data:image/svg+xml' in s
checks['has_toast'] = 'toast' in s.lower()
checks['has_mobile_menu'] = 'hamburger' in s.lower() or 'menu-toggle' in s.lower() or 'navToggle' in s
checks['external_libs'] = bool(re.search(r'<script[^>]*src=|<link[^>]*rel="stylesheet"', s))
checks['inline_style_blocks'] = len(re.findall(r'<style', s))
checks['inline_script_blocks'] = len(re.findall(r'<script', s))

# crude JS brace/paren balance inside <script>
js = ''.join(re.findall(r'<script[^>]*>(.*?)</script>', s, re.S))
checks['js_len'] = len(js)
checks['js_brace_balance'] = js.count('{') - js.count('}')
checks['js_paren_balance'] = js.count('(') - js.count(')')
checks['js_bracket_balance'] = js.count('[') - js.count(']')

# html tag balance for key containers
for t in ['section','div','button','form','header','footer','nav','main']:
    checks[f'tag_{t}'] = len(re.findall(rf'<{t}[\s>]', s)) - len(re.findall(rf'</{t}>', s))

for k,v in checks.items():
    print(f'{k}: {v}')
"}
